title_en: TABLE 12.17: SUPPLY OF WATER ON EMERGENCY BY NUMBER OF ISLANDS , QUANTITY AND EXPENDITURE , 2005 - 2013
title_dv: ތާވަލު 12.17: އެމަޖެންސީ ފެންފޯރުކޮށްދެވުނު ރަށްތަކުގެ އަދަދާއި މިންވަރު އަދި ހިނގި ޚަރަދު، 2005 - 2013
notes: Note: * Expenditure on water and transport that cannot be separated are given under total cost
** In 2010, Province Offices supplied emergency water to the requested islands. Therefore this data is not available at NDMC.
Supply of water on emergency is provided every year from January to July.
